::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests the document-level `panzoom:` setting** in its short forms:
`switch-<value>.qmd` sets `panzoom:` to `true`, `auto` or `false` (the subtitle
says which). It is not part of the website. `panzoom: true` marks every block
image, as Quarto's `lightbox: true` does. The options map, with `match: auto`,
is tested on page C.
:::
